name: motif_add_inflection_feature
description:
Author inflection feature. Research first: motif_guide topic feature-conditioned-slots; check best practice. Use only if the contrast has meaning or takes part in agreement, such as gender, number or tense; otherwise use an inflection class for arbitrary declension or conjugation groups (guide feature-conditioned-slots). Adds a closed morphosyntactic feature and its named values to a Draft. Use the created ids in feature-structure and stem-name authoring, then Dry Run and Trial the Draft before Finalize.
Command: compose-author-inflection-feature. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The Draft to append the authored operations to.
IntentJson: The closed inflection feature input, resolved against the prepared Draft.
